repo.name: graphrag-financial-report
repo.description: GraphRAG over Chinese listed-company annual reports: typed KG + Neo4j + Local/Global Search

commits.message:
feat: initial release of graphrag-financial-report

A teaching-grade GraphRAG pipeline over Chinese listed-company annual
reports: typed knowledge graph (7 entity types, 8 relation types)
extracted via DeepSeek JSON-mode prompts, ingested into Neo4j 4.4 via
MERGE on Entity.uid, clustered with Leiden (python-igraph, no GDS
plugin), and served through a FastAPI /query endpoint with Local and
Global search.

Reproducible artefacts ship under outputs/ (374 triples from a
representative 15-report run, Leiden communities, and a 15-question
GraphRAG-vs-vector-RAG evaluation: 14/15 vs 15/15 answer accuracy,
1.76 s vs 6.02 s mean latency). The 15 annual-report JSONs are
intentionally not committed — supply your own under data/parsed/.
